examples.text: Kannst du mir 1.000.000 Pesos leihen und postlagernd überweisen - bitte?

glosses: A postal service in which a mail is held at a post office to be collected by the recipient

examples.text: This was in the old days, before the expansion of the internet, so we hadn’t received any news from Norway. The only exceptions were letters from girlfriends, friends and family that were sent poste restante to the harbors where we were expected.

glosses: adj. 留邮局待取的，邮件的留局待取，存局候领（写在邮件上的字样）：写于信件上的字样，表明该信件须保存在邮局中，直到收信人去认领
